name: Compose Desktop
description: A Compose Multiplatform desktop app: Material 3, a dark-mode switch, Koin, packaging for Deb / MSI / EXE / DMG and hot reload. Includes the Gradle wrapper.

options.label: Version
options.hint: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, major at least 1 (needed by the Windows and macOS installers)

options.label: App icon
options.hint: PNG, SVG or JPG, 512×512 or larger recommended. Converted to PNG (Linux, window) and ICO (Windows).

options.label: Material icons extended
options.hint: Large dependency; untick for a faster first build
